title: WPSS/17083/1997 of KISHAN SINGH  BHANDARI Vs DISTRICT INSPECTOR  OF SCHOOLS and ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
CLMA DELAY CONDONATION APPLICATION NO.
4584 OF 2008
MCC RECALL APPLICATION NO. 863 OF 2008
IN
CLMA DELAY CONDONATION APPLIATION NO.
11806 OF 2006
MCC RESTORATION APPLICATION NO. 11918 OF
2006
IN
WRIT PETITION NO. 2947 OF 2001 (S/S)
Kishan Singh Bhandari ...........Petitioner.
Versus
District Inspector of Schools, Hardwar & Ors.
 ...............Respondents.
Mr. D. Bishnoi, learned counsel for the petitioner/applicants.
Mr. H.M. Raturi, learned Standing Counsel for the respondents no. 1 and
2.
None appears for the respondent no. 3.
25th July, 2008
Hon'ble P.C. Verma, J.
Application No. 4584 of 2008 has been filed for
recalling the order dated 28.2.2008, whereby the CLMA
Delay Condonation Applications No. 11806 of 2006 and
MCC Restoration Application No. 11918 of 2006 have
been dismissed for want of prosecution.
Perused the grounds shown for delay in filing the
MCC Recall Application No. 863 of 2008. Reasons to
condone the delay are satisfactory. Delay is condoned.
Perused the grounds shown for recalling the order
dated 28.2.2008. Grounds in order to recall the order

2
dated 28.2.2008 are satisfactory. Order dated 28.2.2008
is recalled.
Perused the grounds shown for delay in filing the
restoration application. Grounds with regard to delay in
filing the restoration applications are satisfactory. Delay is
condoned. I find sufficient reason to recall the order dated
5.10.2004. Order dated 5.10.2004 is recalled. Writ
petition is restored to its original number.
All the aforesaid applications are allowed.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties.
By means of present writ petition, the petitioner has
prayed for a writ of mandamus commanding the
respondent to ensure payment of salary to the petitioner
of Class IV employee at Dr. Hari Ram Arya Inter College,
Mayapur, District Hardwar w.e.f. 22.9.1995 upto date also
for future months, along with other teaching and non -
teaching staff of the institution as admissible under the
rules.
Counsel for the petitioner has confined his prayer to
the extent that he may be permitted to file a fresh
representation before the authorities concerned and the
same may be decided as expeditiously as possible.
Prayer is innocuous. Petitioner is permitted to file a
fresh representation before the authority/authorities
concerned within a period of two weeks stating therein his
grievance regarding payment of salary of Class IV
Employee w.e.f. 22.9.1995 upto date. If the same is
moved, the Authority/Authorities concerned shall decide
the same within a period of three months from the date of
production of the certified copy of this order.

3
Subject to aforesaid direction, the writ petition is
disposed of. No order as to costs.
(P.C. Verma, J.)
 25.7.2008
Rathour
